subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI completion notifier, and if so which modes and platform backends are in scope for the first implementation?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing TUI behavior plus config and platform policy; automation cannot choose whether core should own bell, desktop notification, sound, or status-only behavior.

options.title: Specify default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Keep this issue open and settle a minimal opt-in contract covering trigger timing, supported modes, platform behavior, and config before implementation.

options.title: Limit first pass to terminal behavior
options.body: Implement only an opt-in terminal bell or status highlight in core and leave desktop sounds to companion or external surfaces.

options.title: Decline core notification surface
options.body: Keep the TUI as a visual status-only surface and direct alerting work to companion apps, plugins, or broader watchdog items.

recommendation.title: Specify default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and settle a minimal opt-in contract covering trigger timing, supported modes, platform behavior, and config before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current and historical signal on TUI status/finalization paths and adjacent config behavior.
